name: ServerValidation
title: Templates/Platform/Forms/ServerValidation
summary: Where a rejected save renders: a Create Service page whose linked origin is deleted by another user while the form is open. The API rejects the save with a field-scoped error, so it lands as a danger `Alert` under the Origin section heading, the section that owns the broken reference, carrying Reload origins, while the Origin select takes the invalid state. Never a toast, never a validation summary. A dashed simulation panel above the form plays the other user. Same page anatomy as the in-page create form (CreateFormPage): the creation header, section headings over flush `Card` groups of `Item` rows, and a sticky footer, here raised with `z-10`. Built from `SectionHeader`, `SettingRow`, `SaveBar`, `GlobalHeader`, `IconButton`, `Breadcrumb`, `Avatar`, `Tag`, `Card`, `Item`, `Input`, `MultiSelect`, `Select`, `Field` with `RadioButton` choice cards, `Switch`, `NumberInput`, `Skeleton`, `Alert`, `HelperText` and `Button`.

variants.name: Rejected
variants.summary: User 2 deleted web-origin-prod and Save was pressed: the danger Alert opens under the Origin heading with Reload origins, and the Origin select reads This origin no longer exists.

variants.name: Reloading
variants.summary: Reload origins in flight: its button shows the loading state, the Origin select gives way to a Skeleton, and Save is disabled until the list is back.

variants.name: Reloaded
variants.summary: The list is reloaded without the deleted origin: the Alert closes, the select is cleared and flagged required with Select an origin to continue.
